artifacts.summary: Re-measured shellcheck -S warning findings (196/82 files) against the source store, documented the existing lint/lint-*.sh + verify-deploy.sh numbered-gate + tests/test-lint-*.sh fixture pattern (Gate 12/21 as closest analogs) that a new Gate 22 shellcheck lint should follow, and the Logos/Verification exit-70 unresolvable-binary precedent to adopt.

memory_candidates.content: This agent-system repo's lint-gate architecture: a standalone script under agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lint/lint-*.sh (source-store-only, prints an explicit [SKIP] when invoked against a deployed .claude/ consumer tree rather than the source store), wired as one more numbered gate in verify-deploy.sh (gate_selected N guard, CURRENT_GATE="gateN", fail()/pass() helpers, FINDINGS_LIST accumulation when --findings is set), with a sibling tests/test-lint-*.sh fixture suite (mktemp -d workdir, both-polarity assertions: a clean fixture passes, a seeded violation fails) that run-all.sh auto-discovers with no extra wiring. verify-deploy.sh's --only-gate flag validates a hardcoded numeric range at two call sites that must be bumped whenever a new gate is added. No lint gate in this repo has a separate context/standards/*.md doc; each is self-documented in its own script header.

The unresolvable-external-binary convention this agent-system's sibling repo (Logos/Verification's scripts/lint-shell.sh) uses: command -v check first, a named EXIT_UNRESOLVED=70 (not 0, not a generic 1) with an explicit stderr message naming what could not be resolved and stating that no substitute check (e.g. bash -n) was run. Worth reusing whenever wiring any new external-tool-backed lint/gate into this agent-system, to keep a missing-binary failure loud and distinguishable from an ordinary findings failure.
